result.summary: Several layout overflow and clipping issues: category chips, restaurant cards, and names are cut off, and a popular listing is missing its title/details.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Give the last visible card enough inset or allow the carousel to peek without cropping text and imagery.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' listing shows only a pizza image and a -20% badge; the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine are missing.
issues.suggestion: Render the same metadata block as the ramen card (name, rating, time, delivery, cuisine) below the image.

issues.description: The cuisine filter chips overflow the screen edge, with 'Healthy' cut off and the next chip only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/fade or ensure the last fully visible chip isn't cropped so the scroll affordance is clearer.

issues.description: The notification bell badge sits very close to the status-bar battery/signal icons and could collide on some devices.
issues.suggestion: Increase top/right safe-area padding so the badge doesn't crowd the system status icons.
